svg.title: PandeLoot — commerce · ai
svg.desc: A daily loot drop of Filipino bakery treats. Free and discounted drops from the neighbourhood panaderia, live Tambayan chatter, vouchers and Gemini-powered picks. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Gemini API. Live at pande-loot.vercel.app.
